name: Crash Landing on You
description: A paragliding mishap drops a South Korean heiress in North Korea -- and into the life of an army officer, who decides he will help her hide.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes Episodes #1 to #4
videos.overview: Check out how Hyun Bin and Son Ye-jin executed the perfect crash landing and what went on behind their hilarious first kiss on the set of CRASH LANDING ON YOU. Plus surprise cameos from Chong Kyung-ho, Ha Seok-jin, and Park Sung-woong.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes Episodes #5 to #8
videos.overview: A behind-the-scenes look at Hyun Bin and Son Ye-jin’s swoony kiss outside the hospital, Son Ye-jin’s finger hearts for our favorite 5th Company Privates, and more! Bonus: Hyun Bin practicing the piano against the beautiful backdrop of Switzerland.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes Episodes #9 to #16
videos.overview: Can’t move on from CRASH LANDING ON YOU? Neither can we. Here’s more behind the scenes footage from the second half of the shoot, including cameos by Kim Soo-hyun and Choi Ji-woo, and farewell messages from the cast.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Knocked out by fierce winds while paragliding through the air, Yun Se-ri wakes up on the north side of the Korean DMZ, where Ri Jeong Hyeok finds her.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: After talking Jeong Hyeok and his comrades into hiding her in his home, Se-ri gets a taste of his way of life. Gu Seung-jun buys refuge in Pyongyang.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Jeong Hyeok invents a bold background story for Se-ri, but Cho Cheol Gang isn't so easy to fool. Seo Dan returns to North Korea.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: When her escape plan falls through, Se-ri turns to another idea for a way out. Dan heads to the village to see Jeong Hyeok.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Jeong Hyeok agrees to marry Dan sooner, as his parents wish, but they must do him a favor first. Seung-jun catches a glimpse of Se-ri.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Dan is less than happy when she hears Jeong Hyeok and Se-ri are at a hotel together. Meanwhile, Seung-jun plays what cards he has to save himself.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: A flight out of North Korea awaits Se-ri at the airport. But unwilling to leave Jeong Hyeok while he's injured, she brings him to the hospital instead.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Keeping Jeong Hyeok away from Se-ri turns out to be much more difficult than Seung-jun anticipated. Cheol Gang stays on their tail.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Se-ri faces her kidnapper. Elsewhere, Jeong Hyeok is forced to spread a formidable rumor about himself in order to escape Cheol Gang's clutches.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Back to her cushy life in the spotlight, Se-ri takes care of business — though nothing feels quite the same. Jeong Hyeok goes after Cheol Gang.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: It's Jeong Hyeok's turn to adjust to a new world. Back in North Korea, Dan gives Seung-jun a place to stay after he loses his protection.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Hoping to meet Jeong Hyeok, his comrades attend an event hosted by Se-ri's company. Seung-jun opens up to Dan over a bowl of rice porridge.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Se-ri sends the comrades on a shopping spree, and plays hooky from work with Jeong Hyeok. Jung Man Bok encounters a dilemma.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: While Jeong Hyeok keeps watch over Se-ri, his comrades make themselves useful. Seung-jun can't stop worrying about Dan.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: South Korean officials try to figure out what's going on, but they're given conflicting stories. Seung-jun flees from his captors.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Before departing, Jeong Hyeok leaves behind a surprise that keeps on giving. Dan delivers bittersweet justice.
